heading: Pollinator Map
subheading: Our pollinator map shows how our community across London has come together to add pollinator gardens to the city.
participateSubheading:
Have a pollinator garden at home or looking to make one? You can join us! Watch our tutorial video below to learn how to create your map point in a few simple steps.

Please note that you must be logged into a Google account to edit the map. Once you've logged in, follow the "Participate in the map" link below.
